description: This file contains JavaScript functions related to handling address copying between mailing and other addresses, toggling display elements, setting return values for products and contacts, submitting forms for mass deletion, and integrating with Google Maps for address location. It is part of the Contacts module in a CRM system, providing client-side scripting for contact-related forms and interactions.

methods.name: copyAddressRight(form)
methods.description: Copies mailing address fields to their corresponding 'other' address fields in a form.

methods.name: copyAddressLeft(form)
methods.description: Copies address fields from 'other' address to mailing address in a form.

methods.name: toggleDisplay(id)
methods.description: Toggles the display style of an HTML element between 'none' and 'inline'.

methods.name: set_return(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets the selected product's name and ID in the opener window's form, used for selecting a product.

methods.name: add_data_to_relatedlist_incal(id,name)
methods.description: Adds a contact ID and name to the related contact list in the opener window.

methods.name: set_return_specific(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets contact name and ID in the opener window for specific contact selection.

methods.name: set_return_toDospecific(product_id, product_name)
methods.description: Sets contact name and ID in the opener window for Todo-specific contact selection.

methods.name: submitform(id)
methods.description: Submits a form to perform mass deletion based on the provided ID.

methods.name: searchMapLocation(addressType)
methods.description: Constructs an address string from form fields and opens Google Maps with that address.

methods.name: set_return_contact_address(contact_id,contact_name, mailingstreet, otherstreet, mailingcity, othercity, mailingstate, otherstate, mailingcode, othercode, mailingcountry, othercountry,mailingpobox,otherpobox,formName)
methods.description: Populates address fields in the opener contact form based on selected contact details.

ctags.name: set_return_contact_address
ctags.signature: (contact_id,contact_name, mailingstreet, otherstreet, mailingcity, othercity, mailingstate, otherstate, mailingcode, othercode, mailingcountry, othercountry,mailingpobox,otherpobox,formName)
